unit: School of Computer Science
prior: CS dept in College of Science
departments: Computer Science; Machine Learning; Robotics; Language Technologies; HCI; Software Research; Computational Biology
scope: CS, AI/ML, Robotics, HCI, Computational Biology
notes: One of the first standalone CS schools. Porous dept boundaries — faculty can supervise PhD students in any dept.

unit: College of Computing
prior: School of ICS in College of Science & Liberal Studies
departments: School of CS; School of Interactive Computing; School of CSE; School of Cybersecurity & Privacy; School of Computing Instruction
scope: CS, HCI, Computational Media, Cybersecurity, CSE
notes: First 'College of Computing' in the US. ~4,600 UG + ~16,900 grad (incl. OMSCS). Five internal schools. Joint degree in Computational Media with Liberal Arts college.
source: CRA White Paper (2019); Wikipedia; GT Catalog

unit: Khoury College of Computer Sciences
prior: CS formed from Math (A&S) and Industrial Eng (Engineering)
departments: Programs in CS, Data Science, Cybersecurity, AI, Health Informatics
scope: CS, Data Science, Cybersecurity, AI, Informatics
notes: One of the earliest standalone CS colleges (1982). Pioneered 'combined majors' (CS + X). Co-op program central to identity.

unit: Ann S. Bowers College of Computing and Information Science
prior: Faculty of CIS (est. 1999); CS originally in Engineering / Arts & Sciences. Became full College 2020.
departments: Computer Science; Information Science; Statistics & Data Science
scope: CS, Information Science, Data Science, Statistics
notes: Pioneering 'faculty' structure in 1999 became full college in 2020. Spans Ithaca + Cornell Tech (NYC). 76% of UGs take at least one CIS course.
source: CRA White Paper (2019); Wikipedia; Cornell Milestones

unit: Luddy School of Informatics, Computing, and Engineering
prior: CS in Arts & Sciences; new School of Informatics 2000; CS joined 2005; Library Science merged 2013; Engineering added 2016
departments: CS; Informatics; Info & Library Science; Intelligent Systems Eng (Bloomington). Bio-Health Informatics; HCC; LIS (Indianapolis).
scope: CS, Informatics, Library Science, Data Science, Engineering
notes: Informatics BS is inherently 'CS + X' — each student picks a cognate area. Second-largest major at IU-Bloomington.

unit: Kahlert School of Computing
prior: CS division in EE dept (est. 1965); became School of Computing ~2000
departments: Single school; affiliated with SCI Institute and Entertainment Arts & Engineering program
scope: CS, Graphics, Scientific Computing, Games/Entertainment
notes: Historic role in computer graphics (Utah Teapot, ARPANET). School within College of Engineering with significant autonomy via MOU.

unit: Department of Computer Science
prior: CS moved from College of Engineering to College of Natural Sciences; gained School-level status ~2005
departments: Computer Science
scope: CS, AI, ML, Systems, Theory
notes: Transitioned from Engineering to Natural Sciences. Greater autonomy via MOU with dean. One of the largest CS programs nationally.

unit: Manning College of Information and Computer Sciences (CICS)
prior: CS dept in College of Natural Sciences → School of CS 2015 → College ~2017
departments: Computer Science; Information Science (forming)
scope: CS, AI/NLP, Data Science, Information Science
notes: Recent transition from dept to standalone college. Strong in NLP/AI. Dean reports to provost.
source: UMass CICS website; CRA White Paper (2019)

unit: Paul G. Allen School of Computer Science & Engineering
prior: Dept of CS&E in College of Engineering; elevated to School 2017
departments: Single school
scope: CS, Computer Engineering
notes: School-level within College of Engineering, not standalone college. Among top-5 nationally. Gates Center opened 2019.

unit: MIT Schwarzman College of Computing
prior: EECS in School of Engineering; CSAIL and other labs
departments: Shares EECS (reorganized: EE, CS, AI+Decision-Making) with School of Eng; CSAIL; IDSS; ORC; SERC
scope: CS, AI, Data Science, Ethics of Computing, cross-disciplinary
notes: Cross-cutting institute-wide unit alongside MIT's five Schools. First structural change since 1950s. ~40% of UGs major in CS.

unit: College of Computing
prior: CS and Applied Math depts
departments: Computer Science; Applied Mathematics; IT and Management
scope: CS, Applied Math, AI, Cybersecurity, Data Science, IT
notes: Now the largest college at Illinois Tech by enrollment. Dean reports to provost.
source: Illinois Tech website; Dean search posting

unit: College of Computing, Data Science, and Society (CDSS)
prior: Division of CDSS; Data Science UG Studies + Statistics + shared EECS
departments: Shares EECS with College of Eng; Dept of Statistics; Data Science UG Studies; BIDS; D-Lab (shared with Social Sciences)
scope: CS, Data Science, Statistics, Society/Ethics
notes: First new college at Berkeley in 50+ years. UC Regents voted May 2023. Gateway Building opening 2025-26. 1 in 4 CDSS grads holds a second major.

unit: Herbert Wertheim College of Engineering — Dept of CISE
prior: CS & Information Science & Engineering dept within Engineering
departments: Computer Science; Computer Engineering (shared with ECE)
scope: CS, AI, Data Science
notes: Dept-level within Engineering. UF invested $70M in university-wide AI initiative (2020). Included as comparison case.

unit: Department of Computer Science (College of Science)
prior: CS dept in College of Science
departments: CS in College of Science; Applied Computing in Purdue Polytechnic
scope: CS, Data Science (split across colleges)
notes: CS remains in College of Science. Computing activities split across Science and Polytechnic colleges. Included as comparison case.

unit: College of Connected Computing
prior: CS dept in School of Engineering; Vanderbilt Data Science Institute
departments: Computer Science; Data Science (at launch); Scientific Computing; additional depts planned
scope: CS, AI, Data Science, Scientific Computing, cross-disciplinary
notes: First new college at Vanderbilt since 1981. Announced March 2024. Inaugural dean (Matthew Johnson-Roberson, ex-CMU Robotics) started May 2025. CS dept moved from Engineering fall 2025. First UG class expected fall 2027. Emphasizes 'connected computing' — shared faculty with Medicine, Law, Education, etc.
source: Vanderbilt News; College of Connected Computing website

unit: School of Advanced Computing
prior: CS and ECE depts within Viterbi School of Engineering
departments: Thomas Lord Dept of Computer Science; Ming Hsieh Dept of Electrical and Computer Engineering; Division of Computing Education
scope: CS, ECE, AI, Data Science, Quantum Computing, Ethics of Computing
naming: Lord Foundation $260M (part of $1B+ Frontiers of Computing initiative)
faculty: 30 new faculty by 2025; 90 total new by 2030
notes: School-within-a-school under USC Viterbi. USC's 23rd school. Keystone of President Folt's $1B+ Frontiers of Computing initiative. Ginsburg Hall (116K sq ft) opened 2024. Partners with ISI and ICT institutes. Director: Gaurav Sukhatme.

unit: School of Computing, Information and Data Sciences (SCIDS)
prior: Halicioğlu Data Science Institute (est. 2018) + San Diego Supercomputer Center
departments: Halicioğlu Data Science Institute; San Diego Supercomputer Center; joint affiliations with CSE, ECE, Cognitive Science, Mathematics
scope: Data Science, AI, Computing, Information Science
naming: Taner Halicioğlu (HDSI founding gift); no single naming for school
notes: UC Regents approved July 2024. 12th school at UCSD and 4th added in 21st century. Combines HDSI and SDSC. Expected 8,000 students. Dean: Rajesh Gupta. Does NOT include main CS&E dept (remains in Jacobs School of Engineering).
source: UC San Diego News; Wikipedia; SCIDS website

university: University of Texas at San Antonio
unit: College of AI, Cyber and Computing
prior: CS, Data Science, Information Systems depts across existing colleges; School of Data Science (est. 2018)
departments: Computer Science; Computer Engineering; Information Systems & Cyber Security; Data Science & Statistics
scope: CS, AI, Cybersecurity, Data Science, Computer Engineering
notes: Announced Dec 2024, officially launched fall 2025. 9th college at UTSA. 5,000+ students enrolled. Builds on UTSA's nationally recognized cybersecurity programs. Housed in San Pedro I campus; San Pedro II opening Jan 2026.

unit: College of Computing and Artificial Intelligence (CAI)
prior: School of Computer, Data & Information Sciences (CDIS, est. 2019 within College of Letters & Science)
departments: Computer Sciences; Information School; Statistics
scope: CS, AI, Data Science, Information Science, Statistics
notes: UW Board of Regents approved Dec 4, 2025. Expected to begin operations July 1, 2026. First new academic division at UW-Madison since 1983. CS majors tripled from ~1,000 (2015) to ~3,000 (2025). 6,000+ students in CDIS programs.
source: UW News; Badger Herald; CAI website

unit: Artificial Intelligence & Society College
prior: AI Plus Institute; CS and ECE depts remain in existing colleges
departments: Cross-campus unit — does not house traditional departments; works across all 9 existing schools/colleges
scope: AI literacy, AI ethics, cross-disciplinary AI integration
faculty: Director from Philosophy; Associate Director from ECE; leverages existing faculty across campus
notes: Announced April 2025. Unusual model — students don't enroll directly in the college. Instead it infuses AI curriculum across UAlbany's 59 UG majors and 150+ grad programs. Paired with AI & Society Research Center under AI Plus Institute. Funded by Gov. Hochul/SUNY initiative.
